findings.evidence: LocallyClosed.lean:92-96 (the `rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩` branch) only uses `comp_orbitMap` and `Over.comp_left`, the same as ClosedOrbit.lean:81-84.
findings.fix: Factor out `left_apply_smul_mem_orbit (g x a) : (g • x).left a ∈ orbit G x` without the X finite-type instance, derive the `mpr` direction of `left_apply_mem_orbit_iff` from it, and make `hmem` one line using it with `g = 1`.
findings.issue: `hmem` repeats the `mpr` direction of `left_apply_mem_orbit_iff`, which never needs `[LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]`; the lemma is left too strong and the argument is re-proved inline.

findings.evidence: LocallyClosed.lean:147-161 vs 109-122: the same inclusion, proved twice under different hypotheses.
findings.fix: State `orbit_inter_closedPoints_subset : orbit G x ∩ closedPoints X.left ⊆ ⋃ g, Set.range (g • x).left` with only the `G` hypotheses, and use it in `orbit_inter_closedPoints` and `exists_translation_eq_of_mem_orbit_inter_closedPoints`.
findings.issue: `key` proves the `⊆` half of `orbit_inter_closedPoints` without `[LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]`, but `orbit_inter_closedPoints` (line 109) keeps the stronger hypothesis and the general fact is only a local `have`.

findings.evidence: ClosedOrbit.lean:93-102 and LocallyClosed.lean:153-161 run the same `homMk`, `congrArg … comp_orbitMap`, `simp only`, `Scheme.Hom.comp_apply`, `pointOfClosedPoint_apply` chain.
findings.fix: Add one lemma, for example `orbitMap_left_apply_of_isClosed`, giving the rational point `g` with `(orbitMap G x).left c = (g • x).left a` for a closed point `c` of `G`, and use it in both proofs.
findings.issue: Building `g := Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint G.hom c _) _` and proving `(orbitMap G y).left c = (g • y).left a` copies LocallyClosed.lean:153-161 almost line for line.

summary: The hypotheses are dropped correctly, but the proofs re-prove inline special cases of `left_apply_mem_orbit_iff` and `orbit_inter_closedPoints` instead of splitting those lemmas into the general parts that hold without `[LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]`. The same closed-point-to-rational-point step is also copied between the two files.
